title: Promote plugin-object to core package as @object-ui/views
body:
Reclassifies `@object-ui/plugin-object` from plugin to core package, renamed as `@object-ui/views`.

## Changes

**Package Structure**
- Renamed `packages/plugin-object` → `packages/views`
- Updated package name: `@object-ui/plugin-object` → `@object-ui/views`
- Changed keywords/classification from "plugin" to "core package"

**References Updated**
- Site app dependencies and imports
- CLI package aliases and code generation templates
- All documentation (README, reference docs, content/docs)
- CHANGELOG entries for migration tracking

**Migration**
```typescript
// Before
import { ObjectGrid, ObjectForm } from '@object-ui/plugin-object';

// After
import { ObjectGrid, ObjectForm } from '@object-ui/views';
```

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@object-ui/views": "workspace:*"
  }
}
```

All functionality preserved. Zero breaking changes to component APIs.
